sources.read: Sections 1-3 including complete-block feedback, DCT coefficients, endpoint and online ridge; setup and reported comparisons.
sources.finding: EPOC combines residual compression, an explicit endpoint and online ridge correction on a frozen base. Its update contract waits for complete target blocks. Reported performance is external and was not reproduced here.

sources.read: Author abstract and author project page; no implementation or theorem proof reproduced.
sources.finding: GROUSE already estimates and tracks a subspace from incomplete vectors. Adding a mask to low-rank residual fitting is insufficient to establish a new contribution.

sources.read: Primary full-text search result: abstract, sections 2-4; direct open initially returned a bot check.
sources.finding: IPW and augmented kernel estimating equations address missing outcomes under stated MAR and model assumptions; double robustness depends on the stated nuisance-model conditions. They do not supply arbitrary MNAR identification.
Missing-response regression with weighted and doubly robust kernel machines is existing work; detailed comparator derivation remains required.

sources.read: Sections 3-5, particularly per-coordinate RLS, anti-windup, common cached predictions, maturity and delay scope.
sources.finding: The audit already compares delayed adaptation with per-coordinate closed-form correction, common predictions and multiple controls. Spatial missingness is a possible narrower question, not demonstrated novelty from a missing keyword.

concepts.mechanism: Support-conditioned low-rank residual completion before memory retrieval
concepts.equation: For a fixed basis U and observed selector M, z_hat=argmin_z ||M(Uz-r)||^2+lambda||z||^2; correction U z_hat.
concepts.flaw: The estimator is regularized masked least squares; the claimed new part is not specified. Sparse masks can make M U rank deficient.
concepts.cause: Compression plus partial observations combines established tools; geometry and incoherence assumptions determine identifiability.
concepts.repair: Specify a material estimator difference and compare with fixed-basis least squares, online subspace tracking and complete-block correction at equal observations and retained bytes.
concepts.required_evidence: A non-tautological discrimination under matched masks, delay, base predictions, compute and tuning; rank/conditioning failure analysis.
concepts.falsifier: The standard masked estimator matches the candidate at equal cost, or the claimed geometry cannot be identified from visible coordinates.

concepts.mechanism: Doubly robust coordinate-level residual memory under observation selection
concepts.equation: Pseudo-outcome mu(x)+m*(r-mu(x))/pi(x), followed by declared kernel aggregation; pi bounded away from zero.
concepts.flaw: Double robustness and weighted kernels are established; arbitrary outcome-dependent missingness is not identified.
concepts.cause: Unobserved selection factors can violate MAR; small propensities inflate variance; temporal dependence complicates inference.
concepts.repair: Declare a realistic observation design and nuisance-training split; specify what differs from existing weighted kernel methods and what does not.
concepts.required_evidence: Both-nuisance-valid and one-nuisance-invalid controls, positivity diagnostics, independent-trajectory uncertainty, and an MNAR failure case.
concepts.falsifier: Any gain disappears under information-matched IPW/AIPW controls or depends on inaccessible outcome-dependent propensities.

concepts.mechanism: Measurement study of joint spatial censoring and delayed release at fixed revealed-scalar budget
concepts.precise_question: Does the topology of observed coordinates change usable residual information and adapter ranking after matching the observed scalar budget and arrival times?
concepts.flaw: A delay audit alone already exists. A full-block versus partial-block comparison can merely show different usable information, not a better estimator.
concepts.cause: Availability, selection and the model update rule can be confounded; public task contracts may not provide online outcomes.
concepts.repair: Separate information-access effect from estimator effect using a support-matched control and a correct masked estimator; establish a real observation process and admitted data before freezing a study.
concepts.required_evidence: Exact prior-art scope comparison, licensed dataset with meaningful observation timing, equal-information controls and a prospectively bounded endpoint with precision analysis.
concepts.falsifier: Adapter rankings and effect size are explained by usable observations alone, or no scientifically meaningful real observation process supports the setting.

scope: Targeted primary-source review; no exhaustive search or experimental verification claimed.
